SELECT Tuan, COUNT(*) AS DaDong,
  SUM(CASE WHEN XuLyPhut<=SLAPhut THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Dat,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN XuLyPhut<=SLAPhut THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),1) AS PhanTram
FROM HoSo WHERE TrangThai='Đã đóng'
GROUP BY Tuan ORDER BY Tuan;

import pandas as pd
nb = pd.read_csv('so-noi-bo.csv', encoding='utf-8-sig')
dt = pd.read_csv('sao-ke-doi-tac.csv', encoding='utf-8-sig')
def gom(x):
    return x.groupby('MaGD').agg(SoLan=('MaGD','size'), Tien=('SoTienVND','sum'))
bang = gom(nb).join(gom(dt), how='outer', lsuffix='_NB', rsuffix='_DT', validate='one_to_one')
bang['ChenhVND'] = bang['Tien_NB'].fillna(0)-bang['Tien_DT'].fillna(0)
print(bang)
